name: MsoSyncStatusType
description: Specifies the status of the synchronization of the local copy of the active document with the server copy. Used with the Status property of the Sync object.

constants.name: msoSyncStatusConflict
constants.description: Both the local and the server copies have changes.

constants.name: msoSyncStatusError
constants.description: An error occurred. Use the ErrorType property of the Sync object to determine the exact error.
